title: chore: prune agent scaffolding written for older models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Trims `AGENTS.md` instructions that Anthropic's current Opus 5 / Fable 5 prompting guides identify as counterproductive.

- Replaces "use subagents liberally" with explicit delegation limits — Opus 5 delegates more readily than prior models, and the docs recommend capping it
- Drops "never mark complete without proving it works" and the "is there a more elegant way?" self-critique prompt — [the Opus 5 guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5) says explicit verification instructions cause over-verification with no quality gain
- Drops **Task Management** and **Core Principles** — both duplicate instructions the built-in system prompt already carries
- No behavioural/code change; instructions only

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Less scaffolding, more signal
gist.blurb: The agent garden got a light pruning. AGENTS.md now leaves modern models room to work instead of asking them to inspect every leaf twice.
gist.summary: Trimmed AGENTS.md by removing redundant task-management, self-critique, and explicit verification instructions while adding clearer limits on subagent delegation for current Opus 5 and Fable 5 guidance.
gist.impact: Contributors using coding agents get leaner repository guidance that avoids unnecessary delegation and over-verification without changing application behavior.
